title: CMP Security Gateway
description: Live metrics (Prometheus) and per-decision details from the audit trail (PostgreSQL).

list.name: reason
list.label: Reason
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT unnest(reasons) FROM security_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT unnest(reasons) FROM security_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Selection summary (audit trail — follows the filters above)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'allow') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

SELECT count(*) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND action = 'block'

SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

panels.title: Recent decisions — message, decision and why
panels.description: Every decision in the time range that matches the filters. The message is the stored redacted excerpt (sensitive values replaced). Click an id to see every check of that event below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", channel, mode, endpoint, message, action, cmp_action, CASE WHEN monitor_only THEN 'monitor (would block/restrict)' ELSE '' END AS policy, reasons, decided_by, round(risk::numeric, 3) AS risk, round(ml_score::numeric, 3) AS ml_score, rules_fired, bot_tier, sensitive_found, redacted, round(conv_accumulated::numeric, 2) AS conv_risk, round(latency_ms::numeric, 1) AS ms, session_id, session_state, user_id, ip, label, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Why it was flagged — evidence per decision
panels.description: Only blocked / restricted / throttled decisions, with the evidence each check reported.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", message, action, reasons, decided_by, concat_ws(' | ', CASE WHEN rules_fired IS NOT NULL THEN 'rules: ' || rules_fired END, CASE WHEN ml_score IS NOT NULL THEN 'ml ' || round(ml_score::numeric, 3) || ' (restrict ≥ ' || round(ml_restrict_at::numeric, 3) || ', block ≥ ' || round(ml_block_at::numeric, 3) || '; wording ' || round(ml_ngram::numeric, 2) || ', meaning ' || round(ml_embedding::numeric, 2) || ', looks like ' || coalesce(ml_nearest_family, '-') || ')' END, CASE WHEN ml_note IS NOT NULL THEN 'ml: ' || ml_note END, CASE WHEN bot_signals IS NOT NULL THEN 'bot ' || bot_tier || ': ' || bot_signals END, CASE WHEN rate_limited_by IS NOT NULL THEN 'rate limit hit: ' || rate_limited_by END, CASE WHEN reputation >= 60 THEN 'reputation ' || round(reputation::numeric) END, CASE WHEN conv_signals IS NOT NULL THEN 'conversation: ' || conv_signals || ' (risk ' || round(conv_accumulated::numeric, 2) || ')' END, CASE WHEN out_of_scope IS NOT NULL THEN 'not this user''s data: ' || out_of_scope END, CASE WHEN decided_by = 'canary' THEN 'canary token in reply' END ) AS evidence, cmp_action, session_id, user_id, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND action <> 'allow' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: CMP sessions — what CMP was told to do
CMP actions
panels.description: deliver · forward_without_tools · retry_later · refuse · handoff_to_agent · end_contact (customer messages); deliver · send_fallback (AI replies).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(cmp_action, '-') AS cmp_action, count(*) AS decisions FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: By channel and session state
panels.description: Verified = CMP reported a successful identity verification for the session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(channel, '-') || ' / ' || coalesce(session_state, '-') AS "channel / state", count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'allow') AS allowed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'allow') AS flagged FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per CMP session (contact). Copy a session id into the 'Session id' filter to follow it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, channel, session_state, messages, replies, blocked, restricted, throttled, round(max_risk::numeric, 3) AS max_risk, last_cmp_action, reasons, started, last_seen FROM security_sessions_view WHERE last_seen >= $__timeFrom() AND started <= $__timeTo() AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Session timeline (set the 'Session id' filter)
panels.description: Every customer message and AI reply of one session, in order, with what CMP was told each time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", CASE WHEN mode = 'outbound' THEN 'AI reply' ELSE 'customer' END AS who, message, action, cmp_action, reasons, decided_by, round(risk::numeric, 3) AS risk, round(conv_accumulated::numeric, 2) AS conv_risk, conv_signals, session_state, message_id, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND ${session:sqlstring} <> '' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Tuning — near misses and possible false positives
Allowed, but close to the line (possible missed attacks)
panels.description: Messages the model scored 0.3 or more that were still allowed. Read them: real attacks here mean the restrict threshold could be lower.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", message, round(ml_score::numeric, 3) AS ml_score, round(ml_restrict_at::numeric, 3) AS restrict_at, round(ml_ngram::numeric, 2) AS wording, round(ml_embedding::numeric, 2) AS meaning, ml_nearest_family AS looks_like, user_id, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND action = 'allow' AND ml_score >= 0.3 ORDER BY ml_score DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Flagged by the model only (check for false positives)
panels.description: No rule matched; the model alone decided. Normal customer messages here are false positives — label them with POST /admin/events/{id}/label.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", message, action, round(ml_score::numeric, 3) AS ml_score, ml_nearest_family AS looks_like, label, user_id, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND decided_by = 'ml' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: ML score distribution
panels.description: How the model's scores spread. A healthy model puts normal traffic at the left and attacks at the right; a bump in the middle is where tuning matters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(floor(LEAST(ml_score, 0.999) * 10) / 10, 'FM0.0') || '–' || to_char(floor(LEAST(ml_score, 0.999) * 10) / 10 + 0.1, 'FM0.0') AS score, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'allow') AS allowed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'allow') AS flagged FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND ml_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ML threshold check
panels.description: Which model and thresholds decided, how many messages fell in each band, average model time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, ml_threshold_source AS source, round(min(ml_restrict_at)::numeric, 4) AS restrict_at, round(min(ml_block_at)::numeric, 4) AS block_at, count(*) AS scored, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ml_score >= ml_restrict_at AND ml_score < ml_block_at) AS restricted_band, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ml_score >= ml_block_at) AS block_band, round(avg(ml_ms)::numeric, 1) AS avg_ms, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ml_note = 'too_short') AS skipped_short FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (ml_score IS NOT NULL OR ml_note IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Event ${event_id}
panels.description: Paste an event id into the 'Event id' filter at the top, or click an id in any table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", channel, mode, endpoint, message, action, enforced_action, cmp_action, reasons, decided_by, round(risk::numeric, 3) AS risk, policy_version, model_version, ruleset_version, round(latency_ms::numeric, 2) AS ms, session_id, message_id, session_state, user_id, ip, label, label_note FROM security_events_view WHERE id::text = ${event_id:sqlstring}

panels.title: Every check of the event, in order
panels.description: What each check saw: its action, reason, score, time, whether it counted as a strike, and its full detail (rule ids, ML components and thresholds, bot features, conversation state, redactions).

targets.rawSql: SELECT position AS "#", check_name AS "check", action, reason, round(score::numeric, 4) AS score, round(duration_ms::numeric, 3) AS ms, strike, evidence, detail::text AS detail FROM security_event_checks_view WHERE event_id::text = ${event_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY position

SELECT decided_by, count(*) AS requests FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND action <> 'allow' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT f->>'id' AS rule, count(*) AS times FROM security_events_view v JOIN security_event_checks_view k ON k.event_id = v.id AND k.check_name = 'rules', jsonb_array_elements(k.detail->'findings') f WHERE $__timeFilter(v.ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR v.session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(v.reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR v.user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR v.ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR v.message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT coalesce(ml_nearest_family, '-') AS family, count(*) AS messages FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND ml_score >= ml_restrict_at GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT t AS type, count(*) AS found, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(redacted, ''), ', '))) AS redacted FROM security_events_view, unnest(string_to_array(sensitive_found, ', ')) t WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND sensitive_found IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Decisions by endpoint
panels.description: Useful with policies: sensitive endpoints should show more restrictions/blocks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT endpoint, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'allow') AS allow, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'restrict') AS restrict, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'throttle') AS throttle, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'block') AS block, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric, 1) AS p95_ms FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Latency by check (from the audit trail)

targets.rawSql: SELECT k.check_name AS "check", count(*) AS runs, round(avg(k.duration_ms)::numeric, 3) AS avg_ms, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY k.duration_ms)::numeric, 3) AS p95_ms, round(max(k.duration_ms)::numeric, 1) AS max_ms FROM security_events_view v JOIN security_event_checks_view k ON k.event_id = v.id WHERE $__timeFilter(v.ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR v.cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR v.session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(v.reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR v.user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR v.ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR v.message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullif(reasons, ''), 'delivered unchanged') AS reason, count(*) AS replies FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND mode IN ('outbound', 'proxy-outbound') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Replies blocked or changed
panels.description: Canary leaks, someone else's data, secrets, record dumps — and replies delivered with redactions or links removed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", mode, message AS reply, action, cmp_action, reasons, reply_scope, out_of_scope, redacted, images_removed, links_removed, canary_known, session_id, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND mode IN ('outbound', 'proxy-outbound') AND (action <> 'allow' OR redacted IS NOT NULL OR coalesce(images_removed, 0) + coalesce(links_removed, 0) > 0) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE bot_tier = 'suspect') AS suspect, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bot_tier = 'likely') AS likely, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bot_tier = 'bot') AS bot FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND bot_tier IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most bot-like identities
panels.description: Signals: timer, fast_typing, repetition, campaign, rate, automation_ua, missing_ua, hosting_ip.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(user_id, session_id, ip) AS identity, count(*) AS requests, round(max(bot_score)::numeric, 2) AS max_score, (array_agg(bot_tier ORDER BY bot_score DESC NULLS LAST))[1] AS worst_tier, string_agg(DISTINCT bot_signals, ' / ') AS signals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'throttle') AS throttled, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND bot_score > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY max_score DESC, requests DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Sessions at risk
panels.description: Sessions with blocked messages or replies, rising accumulated risk, or a lock. Paste a session id into the 'Session id' filter to see its timeline; reset one with DELETE /admin/sessions/{id}.

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, (array_agg(channel ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS channel, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'inspect') AS turns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'outbound') AS replies, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'block') AS blocked, round(max(conv_accumulated)::numeric, 2) AS max_risk, string_agg(DISTINCT conv_signals, ' / ') AS signals, bool_or('conversation_locked' = ANY(reason_list)) AS locked, (array_agg(cmp_action ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS last_cmp_action, (array_agg(message ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS last_message, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'allow') > 0 OR max(conv_accumulated) >= 0.5 ORDER BY blocked DESC, max_risk DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Most-refused identities
panels.description: Customers appear as cu_… (a keyed hash of CMP's customer id; ban or look one up with the raw id or the hash).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(user_id, ip) AS "customer / IP", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'block') AS blocked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'throttle') AS throttled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'restrict') AS restricted, (array_agg(reasons ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS last_reasons, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND action <> 'allow' AND coalesce(user_id, ip) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY blocked DESC, throttled DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Active bans
panels.description: Lift one with DELETE /admin/bans/{id}?clear_history=true.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.created_at AS "time", b.entity_type AS type, b.value, b.reason, b.source, CASE WHEN b.permanent THEN 'permanent' ELSE to_char(b.expires_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS until, b.evidence::text AS evidence FROM bans b WHERE b.revoked_at IS NULL AND (b.permanent OR b.expires_at > now()) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR (b.entity_type = 'session' AND b.value = ${session:sqlstring})) ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.name, coalesce(p.channel, 'any') AS channel, coalesce(p.session_state, 'any') AS session_state, p.endpoint_pattern AS endpoint, p.mode, p.actions::text AS action_overrides, p.thresholds::text AS thresholds, p.version, p.updated_at FROM policies p WHERE p.active AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR p.channel IS NULL OR p.channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.channel NULLS FIRST, p.session_state NULLS FIRST, p.endpoint_pattern

panels.title: Monitor mode — what would have been enforced
panels.description: Decisions a monitor-mode policy recorded but did not enforce. Review before switching to enforce.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", channel, endpoint, message, action AS would_have, reasons, policy_version, session_id, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND monitor_only ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Accuracy labels
panels.description: Events an admin marked false_positive / true_positive (POST /admin/events/{id}/label).

targets.rawSql: SELECT labeled_at AS "time", label, label_note AS note, message, action, reasons, decided_by, round(ml_score::numeric, 3) AS ml_score, id FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') AND label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY labeled_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Labelled precision
panels.description: Of the flagged events someone labelled, the share that were real attacks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE label = 'true_positive') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE label IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

SELECT coalesce(model_version, '-') AS model, coalesce(ruleset_version, '-') AS ruleset, coalesce(policy_version::text, '-') AS policy_version, count(*) AS decisions, min(ts) AS first_seen, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM security_events_view WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' OR channel = ${channel:sqlstring}) AND (${state:sqlstring} = 'all' OR session_state = ${state:sqlstring}) AND (${mode:sqlstring} = 'all' OR mode = ${mode:sqlstring}) AND (${action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR action = ${action:sqlstring}) AND (${cmp_action:sqlstring} = 'all' OR cmp_action = ${cmp_action:sqlstring}) AND (${session:sqlstring} = '' OR session_id = ${session:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = 'all' OR ${reason:sqlstring} = ANY(reason_list)) AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR user_id = ${user:sqlstring} OR ip = ${user:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR message ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20
